issues.description: The method singFarmSong() is declared to return void in the problem UML and the template, but the solution implements it to return a String. This return-type mismatch is structural and can confuse students: the spec/instructions say the method should print the song (void), while the reference solution returns the assembled song text (String).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method signature consistent across artifacts. Either (A) change the solution to match the specification/template by making singFarmSong() return void and print the song (using System.out.println), or (B) update the problem statement UML and the template to declare singFarmSong() returning String and clarify that implementations should return the assembled song (and tests may assert on the returned String). Prefer (A) to preserve the current pedagogical intent that the method prints the song.
